## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm check` and `pnpm build` pass
- [ ] Changes to `packages/escrow-core` or `packages/contracts` come with tests
- [ ] If fee or settlement maths changed, the shared vectors were regenerated and both suites pass
- [ ] The documentation in `apps/docs` says what the code now does
- [ ] No third-party game assets were added
